common.style_usage: the exact Stardew Valley style of this framed wall painting: square-on, a frame around a small painted picture, one tile is 16 pixels, dark coloured (not black) outlines

margot_by_you.reference_usage: the woman the painting shows: her auburn hair, her face, her green apron; painted loosely and a little clumsily by a beginner
margot_by_you.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a small framed painting hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, one tile is 16 pixels, a plain light wooden frame, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a sweet amateur portrait of a smiling young woman with auburn hair tied back and a green apron, head and shoulders, painted with big uneven brush strokes and a slightly lopsided smile, a warm ochre background

you_by_margot.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a small framed painting hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, one tile is 16 pixels, a plain dark wooden frame, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a careful, slightly stiff first portrait of a young farmer in a straw hat and blue overalls, head and shoulders, looking out with a small smile, against a soft sage green background, painted like a conservator's first try, very neat

north_window.description: Stardew Valley wall decoration, a small framed painting hung flat on a wall, square-on, alone on a transparent background, one tile is 16 pixels, a plain wooden frame, dark coloured (not black) outlines: a painting of a tall cottage window at night seen from inside, four panes, a deep blue night sky with stars and a crescent moon, a lit candle on the windowsill casting warm light, the left half painted neatly and the right half painted loosely
